_meta.tool_description: Execute Python code in a persistent session where `robo` (the robot), `np`, `math` and `time` are defined. Variables, functions and imports persist between calls. Returns stdout, stderr, the exception if any, the value of a trailing expression, the robot state, and the current camera images whenever the robot moved.

tool_params.code:
ctx = world.read_context()
current_image = robo.image("top")
display(current_image[650:990, 350:700])
lemon_record = next(obj for obj in ctx["objects"] if obj["object_id"] == "lemon")
release_pose = np.array(lemon_record["T_W_object"], dtype=float)
lemon_crop = current_image[700:900, 450:650].astype(float)
yellow_mask = (lemon_crop[:, :, 0] > 70) & (lemon_crop[:, :, 1] > 70) & (lemon_crop[:, :, 2] < 0.65 * np.minimum(lemon_crop[:, :, 0], lemon_crop[:, :, 1]))
yellow_rows, yellow_cols = np.nonzero(yellow_mask)
assert len(yellow_rows) > 100
pixel_center = np.array([float(np.mean(yellow_cols)) + 450, float(np.mean(yellow_rows)) + 700, 1.0])
view = ctx["post_action_observation"]["views"][0]
camera_pose = np.array(view["T_W_C"])
ray_world = camera_pose[:3, :3] @ np.linalg.solve(np.array(view["K"]), pixel_center)
release_pose[:3, 3] = camera_pose[:3, 3] + ((0.025 - camera_pose[2, 3]) / ray_world[2]) * ray_world
print("release_center_estimate_m:", release_pose[:3, 3].round(4).tolist())
result = world.commit_step(ctx["interaction"]["pending_update"]["capture"], expected_revision=ctx["revision"], note="Top RGB and paired geometry reviewed after in-place right jaw opening. Lemon visibly dropped below the open fingers and rests inside the plate near its center; plate has no visible displacement. Measured jaw width is 0.069 m. Release position is a calibrated RGB estimate assuming center z=0.025 m, not a depth measurement; orientation is retained as an uncertain prior and the partly occluded upper surface/underside are unresolved. No arm translation was commanded.", poses={"lemon": release_pose.tolist()}, held={"right": None}, relations={"lemon": {"inside": "plate", "supported_by": "plate"}})
print("commit_result:", result)
